notes: Drakkin: reptile pit-fighters on THE LARGE RIG: the frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24) (the normal 2x2 body, 32 px, sits at the centre, its shadow and pathing stay there; the art overhangs it). Mounts and hands are the shared targets moved by (+8,+8), identical relative to the pivot, so every item fits (item top-left = mount - item.grip). A rust and ochre scaled hide, a ridge of bone plates down the spine, shoulder spurs, cream claws, a fan crest on a blunt-snouted head and a thick tail behind (in the legs layer: it swishes with the walk at 7 fps). Head variants: crest, helmet (an iron-banded cap, tinted), scarred. Outfit mask = waist wrap, chest strap, wrist and ankle wraps, the helmet band. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 49x49 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND large: this frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (+8,+8): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig.
